:::{#sol-best-step-evaluate}

```{r}
#| label: best-step-evaluate-r
#| echo: false
bse_eigs_ps <- c(1, 9)
bse_s_star_ps <- 2 / sum(bse_eigs_ps)
bse_kappa_ps <- max(bse_eigs_ps) / min(bse_eigs_ps)
bse_rho_ps <- (bse_kappa_ps - 1) / (bse_kappa_ps + 1)
```

$\matr{S}$ is diagonal, so its eigenvalues are its diagonal entries $1$ and $9$.
Then

$$
\ba
\steplen^* &= \frac{2}{1 + 9} = `{r} bse_s_star_ps`,
&& \text{(best constant step length)}
\\
\condnum(\matr{S}) &= \frac{9}{1} = `{r} bse_kappa_ps`,
&& \text{(condition number)}
\\
\convrate(\steplen^*) &= \frac{`{r} bse_kappa_ps` - 1}{`{r} bse_kappa_ps` + 1} = `{r} bse_rho_ps`.
&& \text{(best factor)}
\ea
$$

:::
